_comment: Registry of dataset sources for LungAI. Facts are marked with a verification status; see docs/data/dataset_source_inventory.md. 'acquisition' says how acquire.py may fetch a source: 'direct' (open HTTPS, no login), 'kaggle_cli' (user's own Kaggle API credentials, never stored here), 'manual' (login, registration or credentialing; the user downloads it).

sources.name: Montgomery County CXR Set (NLM)

sources.citation: Jaeger S, Candemir S, Antani S, Wang YX, Lu PX, Thoma G. Two public chest X-ray datasets for computer-aided screening of pulmonary diseases. Quant Imaging Med Surg. 2014;4(6):475-477. doi:10.3978/j.issn.2223-4292.2014.11.20
sources.license: Research use; do not share outside your research group/organization; forward new requests to NLM; cite Candemir et al. 2014 (IEEE TMI 33(2):577-90, doi:10.1109/TMI.2013.2290491) and Jaeger et al. 2014 (IEEE TMI 33(2):233-45, doi:10.1109/TMI.2013.2284099); attribute NLM. (NLM-MontgomeryCXRSet-ReadMe.pdf, read 2026-11-02)
sources.access: open HTTPS directory listing; no login observed (2026-11-02)
sources.publisher_checksums: S3 ETag in the publisher's index.json (MD5 for single-part objects)
sources.original_labels: normal (filename suffix _0) / TB manifestation (_1); ClinicalReadings text per image (sex, age, finding)

sources.name: Shenzhen Hospital CXR Set (NLM)
sources.publisher: NLM LHNCBC with Shenzhen No.3 People's Hospital
sources.citation: Jaeger S et al. Automatic tuberculosis screening using chest radiographs. IEEE Trans Med Imaging. 2014;33(2):233-45. doi:10.1109/TMI.2013.2284099; Candemir S et al. IEEE Trans Med Imaging. 2014;33(2):577-90. doi:10.1109/TMI.2013.2290491
sources.license: Research use; do not share outside your research group/organization; forward new requests to NLM; attribute NLM and Shenzhen No.3 People's Hospital; cite Jaeger et al. 2014 (IEEE TMI 33(2):233-45) and Candemir et al. 2014 (IEEE TMI 33(2):577-90). (NLM-ChinaCXRSet-ReadMe.docx, read 2026-11-02)

sources.publisher_checksums: S3 ETag in the publisher's index.json (MD5 for single-part objects)

sources.name: Tuberculosis (TB) Chest X-ray Database (Rahman et al.) — 700-TB-image release
sources.publisher: Tawsifur Rahman et al. (Qatar University / University of Dhaka); published by the authors on Kaggle and IEEE DataPort
sources.citation: Rahman T, Khandakar A, Kadir MA, et al. Reliable Tuberculosis Detection Using Chest X-Ray With Deep Learning, Segmentation and Visualization. IEEE Access. 2020;8:191586-191601. doi:10.1109/ACCESS.2020.3031384
sources.license: UNVERIFIED: DataPort page names no license, asks for credit and citation; Kaggle page license not yet read
sources.access: Kaggle account (API token) or IEEE DataPort subscription
sources.original_labels: Tuberculosis / Normal (folder); per-image metadata spreadsheet with source URL
sources.composition_reported: 700 TB = NLM Montgomery + Shenzhen (394) + Belarus (306), per secondary summaries of Rahman et al. 2020; DataPort lists NLM Montgomery and Shenzhen as sources
sources.risk: CRITICAL: likely contains the 58 Montgomery TB images used as the external test cohort. Must be checked by content hash / perceptual hash before any reuse.

sources.name: COVID-19 Radiography Database (Rahman, Chowdhury et al.)
sources.publisher: Qatar University / University of Dhaka team; published by the authors on Kaggle
sources.citation: Chowdhury MEH, Rahman T, Khandakar A, et al. Can AI help in screening viral and COVID-19 pneumonia? IEEE Access. 2020;8:132665-132676. doi:10.1109/ACCESS.2020.3010287; and Rahman T, Khandakar A, Qiblawey Y, et al. Exploring the effect of image enhancement techniques on COVID-19 detection using chest X-ray images. Comput Biol Med. 2021;132:104319.
sources.license: UNVERIFIED (Kaggle page not yet read); upstream sources (BIMCV/PadChest, SIRM, GitHub collections, RSNA) carry their own terms
sources.original_labels: COVID / Normal / Lung_Opacity / Viral Pneumonia folders + metadata spreadsheets (source URL per image)
sources.composition_reported: COVID class 3,616 images; largest share from BIMCV-COVID19+/PadChest, plus SIRM, GitHub collections (incl. Cohen et al.), Twitter, a German medical school (PyHealth documentation; project audit found 143 Cohen images)
sources.risk: Patient identity lost (multiple images per patient possible, e.g. BIMCV series); single-source class; aggregated from web sources

sources.name: Labeled Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) and Chest X-Ray Images for Classification — chest X-ray part (Kermany et al.)

sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (Mendeley Data v2 page, read 2026-11-02)
sources.access: open (Mendeley); Kaggle repackaging needs an account
sources.original_labels: NORMAL / PNEUMONIA (BACTERIA / VIRUS in filename); patient token in filename (personNNN / IM-NNNN)
sources.publisher_checksums: SHA-256 from the Mendeley Data public API

sources.name: TBX11K (Liu et al., CVPR 2020)
sources.citation: Liu Y, Wu YH, Ban Y, Wang H, Cheng MM. Rethinking Computer-Aided Tuberculosis Diagnosis. CVPR 2020:2646-2655. doi:10.1109/CVPR42600.2020.00272
sources.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (official page mmcheng.net/tb, read 2026-11-02); cite Liu et al. CVPR 2020
sources.access: open (official Google Drive or Baidu link on the project page); only train+val released, test labels withheld
sources.original_labels: image folders healthy / sick-but-non-TB / TB; COCO/XML boxes: ActiveTuberculosis (1), ObsoletePulmonaryTuberculosis (2 = latent TB per author), PulmonaryTuberculosis (3, test only)
sources.risk: sick_but_non-TB mapped to Pneumonia (1,395 images); 124 latent-TB images labelled Tuberculosis in V5; no patient IDs

sources.name: VinDr-CXR v1.0.0
sources.publisher: Vingroup Big Data Institute (VinBigData), hosted on PhysioNet
sources.historical_url_used: Kaggle derivative 'vinbigdata-coco-dataset-with-wbf-3x-downscaled' (third-party; boxes fused by weighted boxes fusion; images downscaled 3x) — exact page not located
sources.citation: Nguyen HQ, Lam K, Le LT, et al. VinDr-CXR: An open dataset of chest X-rays with radiologist's annotations. Sci Data. 2022;9:429. doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01498-w
sources.license: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License 1.5.0 (credentialed access + data use agreement)
sources.access: PhysioNet credentialed account, training course, signed DUA
sources.publisher_checksums: PhysioNet publishes SHA256SUMS.txt for each project version
sources.original_labels: 22 local + 6 global labels per image from 3 radiologists (training set); bounding boxes
sources.risk: Historical images are a resized third-party derivative and cannot be matched to the official DICOMs by md5. 1,446 of 1,467 V5 VinDr images carry 2+ findings in the V1 record; 181 'Pleural Effusion' images also carry Nodule/Mass.

sources.name: NIH ChestX-ray14 (ChestX-ray8), Data_Entry_2017_v2020.csv
sources.citation: Wang X, Peng Y, Lu L, Lu Z, Bagheri M, Summers RM. ChestX-ray8: Hospital-scale Chest X-ray Database and Benchmarks on Weakly-Supervised Classification and Localization of Common Thorax Diseases. CVPR 2017:3462-3471. doi:10.1109/CVPR.2017.369
sources.license: No restrictions on use per NIH README (as quoted by mirrors); requires link to the NIH download site, citation, and acknowledgement of the NIH Clinical Center. Confirm in the official README.
sources.metadata_note: Data_Entry_2017_v2020.csv must be downloaded from the Box folder page (no stable direct link recorded).
sources.original_labels: 14 NLP-mined findings + No Finding (multi-label, pipe-separated); genuine Patient ID; Follow-up #; view position
sources.links_source: NIH's own batch_download_zips.py in the ChestX-ray14 Box folder (images/, updated 2020-07-20 by R. Summers, NIH CC/DRD), provided by the user 2026-11-02. NIH names the files images_01..images_12; this project uses images_001..images_012.
sources.publisher_checksums: NIH's script says 'Please check the checksums'; no checksum file has been obtained yet. SHA-256 of each download is logged.
